fields.Name: T140 - MCP Dashboard Tab Navigation
fields.Description: Exercises the @switch (ActiveTab) tab-navigation code and the four per-tab content branches (servers/connections/tools/logs), plus the tab-dependent header actions — not covered by the basic 'MCP dashboard renders' test.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the AI application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), then open the MCP section from the AI app's LEFT nav. The MCP Dashboard has a tab bar with four tabs: Servers, Connections, Tools, and Logs. Click each tab in turn and confirm the main content area changes to that tab's distinct view (server cards, connection cards, a tools-grouped-by-server area, and a logs table respectively). Success is that switching tabs re-renders different content per tab — each tab may show data OR its own empty-state (e.g. 'No MCP servers configured', 'No tools discovered yet', 'No recent execution logs'). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A tab bar with Servers, Connections, Tools, and Logs tabs is visible on the MCP Dashboard
Clicking each tab switches the highlighted/active tab and re-renders the content area with that tab's distinct view or a tab-specific empty-state
The header primary action changes with the tab (e.g. 'Add Server' on Servers, 'Add Connection' on Connections, 'Test Tool' on Tools)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
